title: anthyllis vulneraria f. alba
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria f. alba, commonly known as White Kidney Vetch, is a flowering plant that belongs to the legume family and is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating wounds, gastrointestinal issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of White Kidney Vetch include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of White Kidney Vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
